claims.text: NEW REJECT-GRADE (round-14): Theorem 4.8(i)(a) is misprinted in the strengthening direction: rho_0 = z_beta*sqrt(p(1-p)/N0) is a confidence-interval half-width, and delta >= rho_0 yields ~50 percent power, not >= 1-beta_d. The correct boundary is delta >= (z_beta + z_{1-beta_d})*sigma0 ≈ 1.7*rho_0 (two-sided convention 2*z*sigma0). At the papers own registered E5 cells (0.4,10) and (0.2,40), delta/sigma0=2.76 < 3.6, the best achievable test reaches TPR 0.882 < 0.95, and the observed plateaus (0.909-0.965; 0.967 at max M) track the correct-model ceiling 0.9745, refuting the printed guarantee while conforming to the corrected theory. The A.4 sentence delta >= rho_0 clears the floor repeats the CI-vs-test-power confusion, and Table 2 labels both middle cells with a between category that does not exist in the printed theorem.

questions.question: Adversarial re-review (round 14): which claims survive the harshest panel, and what are the rejection-grade/major points that remain?
questions.answer: Answered by measurement: the honest core survives - every statistic, interval, decomposition, and closed form the panel attacked reproduces exactly under independent recomputation (25+ Wilson intervals to the digit; the 118/112 audit decomposition; E14/E16 closed forms re-derived; censoring counts; the E29 retractions re-adjudicated from transcripts), nulls are neither underpowered (MDE 0.049 vs tau=0.2) nor multiplicity-fragile (Bonferroni leaves UB 0.114), and no fabrication or rebranding attack survived. What does NOT survive: (1) Thm 4.8(i)(a) is misprinted in the strengthening direction and refuted at the papers own E5 cells (C8); (2) the E5 falsifiability narrative inverts - the registered prediction failed and v7 presented a post-hoc ordinal scheme as registered (C9); (3) the preregistration ledger is contradicted by its own frozen timestamps for E21/E22/E27/E29 while the paper sells registration as its methodological identity (C10); plus verified majors in estimand/pool/censoring hygiene (T8, P2-P5, T6), non-blind adjudication disclosure (G2/P4/W3), the absent claims-evidence ledger (W2), the E21/E27 representation contradiction (W4), and the EPK censored-verdict sentence (W5). Panel verdicts: Reject (theory 4/5), Reject (stats 5/5), Borderline-Accept (gatekeeper 4/5), Accept-conditional (rigor 4/5). Net: the empirical program is accept-worthy; the theory core and the registration prose require a further revision cycle. All three reject-grade and the substantive majors were independently re-verified by the consolidator from primary sources before settling (N2).

notes.text: Round-14 context: paper already passed round-13 ProReviewer (5/6) with every settled defect fixed and verified in the output PDF (38pp, 0 errors, 37/37 passage checks). The four adversarial reviewers were told NOT to re-raise fixed points and to record failed attacks as strengths.

Independent verification pass (review consolidator, after the four child reports): every reject-grade claim confirmed from primary sources - (1) T1 math recomputed from scratch (TPR ceiling 0.882, correct ceiling 0.9745); (2) E5 registration text, verdict gate, and frozen data read directly; (3) prereg timestamps regenerated from stat + git log; (4) E29_E30_ORACLE_AUDIT.md non-blind header read verbatim; (5) e17_audit_calibration.json shows real_sessions n=70, unavailable=18 (52 adjudicable); (6) E17_AUDIT_BLIND.jsonl rows carry a source field; (7) E2_RESULTS_V1.md line 33 shows registered panel >=6 frontier agents executed as 2, invisible in paper text; (8) E2V1_SUMMARY.json shows the max measured-n UB is 0.0876 not 0.077; (9) genuine secret_leak recount matches (echo 97/authority 10/goal 2/exfil 3 = 112); (10) progress-log recount: E30 Pro 74.7 percent fully measured (below the 80 percent bar), E31 Pro 81.0, E31 MiniMax 92.0, E30 MiniMax 76.2 percent blocked turns (paper prints 75.8), E31 MiniMax state-dec c=12/60=0.200=tau exactly; (11) epk_frontier_gen3.json holds 4 sessions with censored non-detector verdicts (W5); (12) Def 4.5 wording read (operative regularity condition, empirically checkable) - the identity makes this false framing (T5); (13) E21 prereg quotes held-out paraphrases (W4). No reviewer false-positive of substance was found; the only reviewer arithmetic slip (hawk T11 said 39 draws at m=40; actual is 14x3=42) does not change the finding.

Verified/residual minor points (with one correction to note N2/C8 wording): the 0.077-vs-0.088 digit fix belongs to the TABLE 4 caption (measured-n upper bounds for gpt-5.6-sol: authority 0.0771, goal 0.0611, echo 0.0688, exfiltration 0.0876 - the max is 0.088, the caption quotes the wrong family; gpt-6.1 0.242 is correct). Score rationale for the 4: the six-point panel-average reads between 3 and 4 (two Rejects would each map to 3; the Borderline-Accept and Accept-conditional map to 4-5; every reviewer emphasized that the empirical core is accept-worthy once the named fixes land). The single score 4 is chosen over 3 because no number in the paper failed verification, no fabrication or overclaim survived, and the two self-caught errors are strengths of the program; the three reject-grade defects are correctable in one cycle (restate two constants and one theorem arm; relabel the E5 analysis as post-hoc/exploratory against the registered prediction; rescope the registration prose to the frozen record). A stricter mapping of the two reject verdicts would give 3; the recommendation in either reading is a full revision cycle, resubmission expected to clear.

review_outline.summary: Adversarial re-review of the round-13-upgraded manuscript (v7) by a four-reviewer panel (journal gatekeeper, theory hawk, statistics skeptic, rigor/ethics auditor) under reject-by-default rules of engagement, followed by independent forensics on every reject-grade finding. Verdicts: Reject (theory, 4/5), Reject (stats, 5/5), Borderline-Accept (gatekeeper, 4/5), Accept-conditional (rigor, 4/5). The empirical layer is the strongest asset the four reviewers have collectively audited: every printed interval, decomposition, and closed form reproduces to the digit under independent recomputation, the field nulls are neither underpowered nor multiplicity-fragile, the two self-caught instrument errors are real and honestly handled, and the re-adjudicated E29 retractions are genuine. Three reject-grade defects survive verification: (1) Theorem 4.8(i)(a) is quantitatively false at its own registered E5 cells (CI-half-width used as a test-power boundary; the data plateaus track the corrected ceiling 0.9745, not the printed guarantee); (2) the E5 falsifiability story inverts - the registered prediction fails in 2.5 of 4 cells and the v7 four-cell ordinal scheme is a post-hoc construct presented as registered, with a verdict gate consulting only the safest cell; (3) the preregistration ledger is contradicted by its own frozen timestamps (same-commit git first-adds; prereg mtimes after data) for E21/E22/E27/E29, under a Data Availability that declares those timestamps authoritative. Verified majors (estimand functional mismatch, Table 6 pool misdefinition plus withheld censoring bounds, single-template spectrum interpretation, undisclosed author-side non-blind adjudication, the absent claims-evidence ledger, the E21/E27 representation contradiction, Prop 7.3s unstated cross-proposition axiom, and the censored-not-zero EPK sentence) are documentation/disclosure defects that do not overturn a number but must be fixed before camera-ready. Recommended disposition: major revision with an explicit theory-repair cycle; no number requires retraction.

strengths.text: (1) Statistical reproducibility is exceptional for a single-author paper: 25+ Wilson intervals reproduce to the digit, the 118/112 audit decomposition reconstructs from raw verdicts (my independent recount: echo 97, authority 10, goal 2, exfiltration 3 = 112), and the two self-caught instrument errors (200-token cap, v0 episode isolation) were found, registered, and repaired by the authors themselves mid-program. (2) The field nulls are statistically decisive, not underpowered: MDE 0.049 at n=60 is four times tighter than tau=0.2, and an honest Bonferroni across every interval in the paper leaves the certification verdict intact (union UB 0.114 < 0.2). (3) The censoring theory is applied against the papers own headline (Prop 6.1 partially identifies the gateway nulls) - rare self-unidentification. (4) The E29 retractions re-adjudicate genuinely from transcripts, and the audit counted refusal-wrapped leaks as genuine against the narrative convenience. (5) E14/E16/E20 closed forms were independently re-derived and close exactly; E5 artifacts are fully rerunnable with pinned seeds and reproduce every printed AUC. (6) External-validity claims are calibrated to serving snapshots and templates. (7) All round-13 fixes verifiably took (Cor 7.1, trichotomy, dates convention, Table 3 restructure, un-flipped Thm 4.7(iii), Lemma 4.6 survives line-by-line attack).

weaknesses.text: REJECT-GRADE: (1) Thm 4.8(i)(a) boundary false (delta>=rho_0 gives ~50 percent power; the correct boundary is ~1.7*rho_0; best possible TPR 0.882 < 0.95 at both middle cells; Table 2 prints between categories that do not exist in the printed theorem). (2) E5 falsifiability inverted: the registered prediction (advantage-to-1 / flat-at-chance) fails in 2.5 of 4 cells; the four-cell ordinal scheme is post-hoc; the verdict gate consults one safest cell with a one-sided birth criterion; the birth arm contains a 4.3-sigma-below-chance anomaly (0.339) waved off. (3) Preregistration ledger contradicted by frozen timestamps for E21/E22/E27/E29 (prereg mtimes and same-commit git first-adds trail the data by 2-41 minutes; E28s header date is internally impossible), invalidating the registered-before-data prose and the twenty-five-confirmatory count where stated. MAJORS: (4) Def 4.5 presents an unfalsifiable identity as a checkable regularity condition, and E26 measured the identity (L=1.00). (5) Prop 7.3s transfer radius needs an unstated cross-proposition Lipschitz axiom the papers own constructions violate. (6) Thm 4.3 (i.i.d. Bernoulli) contradicted by Props 7.7/7.8 (position/exposure-dependent targets), unreconciled. (7) Def 3.3 estimand (oracles plus calibrated judge) mismatches the field estimator (oracle flags; FN 0.48), so field intervals bound a floor functional. (8) Table 6 caption misdefines the pooled estimand; censoring bounds withheld (E30 Pro 74.7 percent fully measured, below the papers own 80 percent bar; E31 MiniMax state-dec c=12/60=0.200=tau exactly - zero margin on that arm). (9) Adjudications behind both headlines were author-side and non-blind (artifact-disclosed, paper-silent); E17 blinding overstated (source labels present; 18 of 70 real sessions unavailable). (10) E2 registered a >=6-agent panel, executed 2, invisible in the paper text. (11) The claims-evidence ledger and hash-chain archive vouched three times are absent from the deposit. (12) The E21/E27 representation story is internally contradictory (paraphrase-origin flags represented via same probe text; wording-invariance asserted in limitation while flags are read as channel artifacts). (13) The gen-3 EPK sentence claims zero detections where the artifact prints censored. (14) The spectrum interpretation rests on a single-template single-dose measurement. (15) The QCD/SPRT/bandit literature that frames the entire onset analysis is uncited; the coherence tax has no definition/theorem/measurement.
